$comment: keyforms.json, version 1 (FORMAT.md §4): unchanged from v3; a package declares it in files.keyforms.
title: LivLiv head-turn key poses (keyforms.json v1)

cell.description: The grid cell, in canvas pixels.

units.description: Pixels per unit in the displacement data.

turn.description: tuning.turn when the poses were measured.

nod.description: tuning.nod when the poses were measured.

param.description: diag: a pose only a caller weights (a multi-view player's corners), not an angle.

fields.description: One displacement field per group: key head, hair, torso or a layer id; value base64 int16 (dx, dy interleaved, row-major, rows x cols). A converter that renames a layer renames its key here too.

same.description: Groups whose field is head's, stored once.

mask.description: Per group, uint8 weights on the same grid (255 = all): how much of the measured pose a vertex takes.

interp.description: Each angle's -v and +v poses blend as Hermite; missing: linear.
